description: This file implements an IPM (Inter-Processor Message) driver for the ARM MHU (Message Handling Unit) in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, interrupt handling, status retrieval, and message sending functions.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_get_cpu_id
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU ID by reading a specific register based on device configuration.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_get_status
methods.description: Gets the interrupt status for a specified CPU ID.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified CPU ID by setting a register.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_max_id_val_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum ID value supported.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPM device and configures its interrupt.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine that handles incoming messages and invokes callback.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the IPM device (stub implementation).

methods.name: ipm_mhu_max_data_size_get
methods.description: Returns the maximum data size supported for messages.

methods.name: ipm_mhu_register_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback function for message notifications.
